items.title: Lakers are ‘real’ deal — even Victor Wembanyama thinks so
items.summary: Like the rest of us, Victor Wembanyama was skeptical of the Lakers. The darlings of the NBA entered Friday’s game against the Spurs with the top record in the NBA at 15-3. But they hadn’t played the league’s most elite teams. They hadn’t really proven themselves. So, Friday was a temperature check. It was a harsh dressing room mirror that would expose their flaws in front of a national television audience. How did they do? “As a team I wasn’t sure what they were built of, at least from the start of the season,” Wembanyama acknowledged. “But it’s real.”The Lakers lost, 99-96. But the final score was far less important than what transpired. The Lakers led by as much as 20 points. They bottled up Wembanyama in the first half, holding him to just eight points on nine shot attempts and five rebounds. items.title: Jazz’s Jusuf Nurkic To Make Season Debut Friday
items.summary: Jazz center Jusuf Nurkic will make his 2026/27 regular season debut on Friday against Denver, the team announced today (via Twitter). The Bosnian big man was originally listed as questionable for Friday’s game vs. the Nuggets. Nurkic suffered a partial plantar plate tear of the second toe in his right foot during Utah’s preseason opener on October 4. He has been sidelined for the past seven-plus weeks due to the injury. A former first-round pick (16th overall in 2014), Nurkic was cleared to begin on-court work three weeks ago and has been ramping up his activity since then. The 32-year-old is in his 13th year in the NBA. Nurkic was limited to 41 appearances in 2025/26, his first season in Utah, but he made 36 starts and averaged 10.9 points, 10.4 rebounds and 4.8 assists in 26.4 minutes per night while shooting 50.3% from the field. items.summary: Star guard Stephen Curry, who has missed the last six games after suffering an oblique abdominal tear on his right side, will be sidelined for at least three more contests, the Warriors announced today (via Twitter). According to the team, Curry is “making good progress” in his recovery and has begun individual on-court workouts. The four-time NBA champion be reexamined next Wednesday. items.summary: Defending champion Germany, which won the 2023 FIBA World Cup behind strong play from MVP Dennis Schröder, was among five teams that qualified for the 2027 FIBA World Cup on Friday. The German men’s national team, currently No. 2 (behind the United States) in FIBA’s world rankings, defeated Latvia by two points on Friday to improve to 8-1 in Group K of the European qualifiers. Olympic silver medalist France, No. 3 in FIBA’s rankings, also secured a spot in next year’s World Cup on Friday by improving to 8-1 in the qualifiers. France, which finished a disappointing 18th at the 2023 World Cup, defeated Estonia to qualify for the 32-team tournament. items.summary: Lakers guard Austin Reaves has been upgraded to available for Friday’s showdown vs. San Antonio, the team announced today (Twitter link via Marc Stein).
